description: Review of sections that are NOT classed CONVERSION but carry CTA-like copy (purpose text or a cta or button content field), found by the scan in extraction/verify_all.py check_classification. A block whose primary purpose is conversion is reclassified as CONVERSION (brand.press-kit was); an entry here records why the CTA is secondary. attestation agent = an automated reviewer, not a human sign-off. A stale entry fails the check.

entries.justification: The cards are editorial post and story links (FEED); the single optional header button is a "view all" link beside the title, not a conversion ask.
